name: reader-spike
description: Answer a question and write it down: investigate, scope the doc, then an independent review that judges the findings' citations. Every step is server-executable.

steps.name: investigate
review

name: reader-planning
description: Turn spike findings into slices through the worktrack MCP, then gate on at least one slice existing. The old manual 'slices-minted' gate could not be cleared by a drain.

steps.name: decompose

name: reader-slice
description: Implementation slice: implement, scope, build, full suite, independent review.

steps.name: implement
review

name: reader-bugfix
description: Bug fix, test first. The previous version had NO implementer: it ran the suite, checked scope, ran the suite again and asked for a review of nothing.

steps.name: implement
review

name: reader-epic
description: Epic container: wait for the slices, then prove the tree still builds and passes.
